summary: Backend-only smoke + integration tests for AutomaERP. Ran full test script against public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL covering auth, plans, payments (simulated paid via mongo), company creation gating, CEO perms, full ERP CRUD, materials reservation lifecycle, client history + previous_notes, vehicle status transitions, RMA stock decrement, employee granular permissions, subscription expiry gating, tenant isolation with two companies, and object-storage upload/download. All 17 checks passed.
passed: GET /api/plans returns 3 plans with correct amounts (10000/25000/90000)
POST /api/payments/checkout requires JWT and returns checkout_url/session_id; status flips to paid after mongo update
POST /api/companies rejected with 402 when no paid transaction
POST /api/companies succeeds with paid txn; consumes it; sets subscription_expires_at ~30 days ahead
Materials reservation: create O.S. with qty_taken=3 -> product.reserved=3, vehicle.status=in_use
Finalize O.S. with qty_used=2 -> product.quantity=8, reserved=0, vehicle.status=available, signature uploaded
Client history sorted desc + new O.S. carries previous_notes from prior one
RMA reduces product qty by 1 and records stock_movement
Employee w/ obras.view only: GET /api/clients 200, POST /api/clients 403, GET /api/products 403
Subscription expiry: past subscription_expires_at -> GET /api/orders returns 402
Tenant isolation: second company sees empty /api/clients
POST /api/upload + GET /api/files?path=&token= returns exact file bytes
